resources.string: When on, the app colors follow your system wallpaper. When off, the app color is used.
When dynamic color is on, the app colors follow your system wallpaper colors and change with the wallpaper. Turn on dynamic color?
Choose the app theme color. The main interface color changes with it. Unavailable while dynamic color is on.
To use this feature, please turn off dynamic color first
Choose the color of text in the app. Text on all screens changes with it.
Follow system switches with the system dark mode. Light always uses a light interface. Dark always uses a dark interface.
